steps.title: Confirm the Yukon stream and worker eligibility
steps.description: The offered job must be TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3. The foreign worker needs at least 12 months of full-time relevant experience in the prior 10 years, suitable education and licensing, valid status if in Canada, and intent to live in Yukon. Language minimums are CLB/NCLC 6 for TEER 0 or 1 and CLB/NCLC 5 for TEER 2 or 3.

steps.title: Confirm the full-time, year-round Yukon job offer
steps.description: The offer must be a genuine full-time, year-round position with an eligible Yukon employer, normally 35 to 40 hours per week, at the Yukon median wage for the NOC.

steps.title: Confirm employer eligibility and recruitment
steps.description: The employer must meet Yukon operating, registration and licensing rules and show unsuccessful recruitment of Canadians or permanent residents. The position must be advertised for at least four weeks in at least three places, including Job Bank and two local media.

steps.description: Yukon's two published 2026 EOI intakes are closed. A new EOI is required for each intake and previous submissions do not automatically carry over.

steps.description: The employer submits one EOI for the foreign worker during an announced intake. The EOI is scored against current priorities and is not a program application.

steps.description: Highest-ranking employers are invited according to annual allocation and priorities. An invited employer must attend the information session and follow the application deadline in the invitation.
